sermon.title: Satan’s Secret Weapon That Destroys Those Who Hear, Believe, and Accept The Gospel 07/08/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer looks at the rocky ground in the parable of the sower: people who receive the word with joy but fall away. Tests and mistreatment are common and bearable, as his Detroit youth showed. The real cause is having no root (Jesus), no depth (a plowed heart) and no water (the word), so believers must avoid man-made doctrines and stay rooted in Christ.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Private names (a classmate, his son) stay in the transcript only. Garbled words are marked [unclear]. Kept as spoken: “everybody is going to heaven folks” where the point is that not everyone is (40:45); “I’m 75 and I’m falling away” where he means he is not (53:25); “Mark 8:17” for the warning about the scribes’ and Pharisees’ doctrine. Unverified: illegal immigration costs half a trillion dollars (43:14); the last awakening ended in the eighties. Sensitive content kept as spoken: American youth and parents are “wimps” and kids “weaklings” (8:26, 49:21). Detroit stories: mugged at knifepoint by four black boys, “I pooped my pants”, black moviegoers rubbing his arm, ethnic gangs, Mexicans and Latinos claiming asylum (13:50–17:18). Liberals “lying” about Ben Carson’s neighborhood (18:20). Groped by girls from age five and propositioned by homosexuals, a Me Too comparison (19:23). On girls who got drunk and lost their virginity at parties: “don’t come wanting a date with me… I don’t want secondhand stuff” (21:48). Hindus and Buddhists “not gonna get you anywhere”; Muslims as a “religion of peace”: “where is your brains” (28:42, 38:25). Women with strict dress rules “look like a zombie” and propositioned him (32:15). Open-borders supporters are “idiots”; his father would “drop” an intruder; jail illegal immigrants and deport them (40:45–43:14). Kentucky “poor white trash”, inbreeding and “mongrel kids… distorted” (43:14). Border family separation compared to removing a prostitute’s child (44:44). Socialist, liberal and atheist platforms “out to destroy America” (46:00). Schools teach homosexuality and transgenderism (49:21). Ben Shapiro “missed it big time” (31:03).
